summary: Iter 368 — Activation Funnel drill-down feature batch (4 new pieces). All 12 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend Playwright validation passes: bottleneck summary banner renders with real text (61 users (100.0%) signed up but haven't connected GitHub yet — this is your biggest bottleneck right now.), exactly one 'MOST STUCK' pill (on signed_up matching the summary), all 5 funnel-count-<key> buttons are clickable and open the funnel-stage-users-modal with real users (61 rows for signed_up, sorted longest-stuck first). Empty-stage (connected_github, added_project, sent_message, shipped_code) modals correctly show 'No real users currently stuck at this stage.' Close via X and via overlay both work. The pre-existing funnel-nudge-stage-card remains rendered right below and is unaffected. On /admin/users -> UserDetail, the new 'Emails sent (0 funnel nudges)' card renders between Activity Logs and Support tickets with 'No nudge emails sent to this user yet.' for a user without nudges. No new console errors on /admin/overview or /admin/users detail. Feature is functionally correct end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminOverview.jsx is 2125 lines — approaching maintainability ceiling; consider extracting FunnelCard/StageUsersModal to their own files in a future refactor (not blocking).
Admin.jsx is 3711 lines — same concern, UserDetail alone is a ~500 line component; splitting into modular cards (ActivityLogsCard, EmailsSentCard, SupportTicketsCard) would help.
activation_funnel/stage-users endpoint is uncached (by design per docstring). If it is ever hit from a public/anon path in future, add rate limiting; currently protected by _require_admin so fine.
_compute_stage_buckets swallows exceptions on github_installations lookup silently (try/except pass); consider logging so a broken lookup doesn't silently under-count without any signal.
